title: Recording: Who Has Seen The Wind by Yoko Ono | 1970
content:
Studio 1, De Lane Lea Studios, London
Producer: John Lennon

Yoko Ono’s song ‘Who Has Seen The Wind?’ was recorded on 30 January 1970.

The session took place at De Lane Lea Studios on 75 Dean Street, London, with John Lennon producing.

‘Who Has Seen The Wind?’ was released as the b-side of Lennon’s ‘Instant Karma!’ single. The music featured Lennon on guitar, Ono on recorder, and arranger John Barham on harpsichord.

The opening lines were from a 19th century poem by Christina Rossetti:

Who has seen the wind?
Neither you nor I:
But when the trees bow down their heads,
The wind is passing by.
